scope: Zero-model cloud config bundle startup diagnosis; no Codex exec/resume, model inference, simulation, budget reservation, or STARTED.

attempt2_error.direct_error: Error: timed out waiting for cloud config bundle after 20s

source_evidence: codex-rs/cloud-config/src/service.rs defines CLOUD_CONFIG_BUNDLE_TIMEOUT as Duration::from_secs(20), wraps startup load in timeout, and emits the observed timeout message.
codex-rs/exec/src/lib.rs calls managed_config_bundle_loader_for_storage before final config loading; a bundle error fails configuration loading.
codex-rs/backend-client/src/client.rs maps the ChatGPT backend base URL to GET /wham/config/bundle.
codex-rs/cloud-config/src/service.rs prefers a valid identity-matched cache and otherwise fetches remote with retries.
codex-rs/login/src/oauth_session.rs refreshes an expired OAuth token before the bundle request; storage lock timeout is 60 seconds and can be bounded by the outer 20-second cloud timeout.

timeline.event: Attempt2 CLI STARTED; runner timeout was 3600s and did not fire.
Codex exited 1 after writing the 20-second cloud-config timeout to stderr; stdout and JSONL remained empty.
Targeted zero-model GET to the source-identified bundle endpoint returned HTTP 401 token_expired in 1231 ms.
Official auth.openai.com OpenID configuration returned HTTP 200 in 1191 ms.

cloud_config_bundle_cache.consequence: Startup could not use a cache hit and had to authenticate and fetch remotely.

attribution.confirmed_configuration_semantics: Cloud bundle supplies enterprise-managed config and requirements fragments; startup waits and fails closed.
attribution.confirmed_network_status_now: Both bundle endpoint and auth issuer reached promptly through the normal local proxy.
attribution.confirmed_auth_status: Stored access token expired before attempt2; expired-token bundle request returned promptly with HTTP 401.
attribution.excluded_now: The normal proxy listener is present, and current endpoint/auth-issuer checks do not reproduce a 20-second hang.
not_excluded: OAuth refresh was slow, blocked, rejected in a way that did not finish within the outer timeout, or entered interactive login.
Transient mihomo/upstream/network failure occurred only during attempt2.
An unrelated cloud-config service fault occurred only during attempt2.
attribution.attempt1_root_cause_remains: OUTER_HOST_EXECUTION_SESSION_CANCELLATION with 18 model catalog refresh warnings non-decisive; not merged into attempt2.

checks_performed.name: bundle_endpoint_expired_token_probe
checks_performed.credentials_used: normal local OAuth token; value not printed or archived

minimal_fix.rationale: The 20-second timeout is a source constant with no observed supported override. Current network checks are healthy, while stored auth is expired; performing an OAuth refresh or re-login would change user credentials and is an external/user action.
minimal_fix.recommended_user_action: Refresh/re-authenticate Codex through the supported normal flow, then verify codex-cli 0.166.0 and a single bounded authenticated bundle probe or allow one explicitly authorized startup.
forbidden_actions: No timeout bypass or cloud-config check disablement.
No automatic CLI upgrade/downgrade without compatibility evidence.

recovery_preparation.cumulative_start_accounting: A future authorized startup would be attempt 3 and used_real_cli_starts=3; budgets are not reset.
recovery_preparation.on_new_service_fault: Stop immediately, preserve STARTED/result evidence, do not retry/resume or launch another CLI.
